What if you never wore sunglasses?
Lots of people only wear sunglasses to look cool. Squinting works fine, right? Light bouncing off snow, sand and water makes it even stronger.

But here's the twist. UV rays can actually sunburn your eyes, and years of sun are linked to cataracts, so the best sunglasses block one hundred percent of UV! Dark lenses alone don't mean UV protection, so check the label.
